title: QUITO: Accelerating Long-Context Reasoning through Query-Guided Context Compression
selection_reason: QUITO computes question-to-context attention with a trigger token and filters context under a length budget, a query-guided context compression method that reduces reasoning complexity and computation cost for in-context learning.
